|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “USED: ▲ Demotion. OR Target a non-Jedi Imperial present with another Imperial. Cancel target's game text for remainder of turn. LOST: Cancel Imperial Command (except when limiting your battle destiny draws).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dark Dissension (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “USED: Take Demotion into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR For remainder of turn, cancel the game text of an Imperial (except a Dark Jedi) present with another Imperial.<br />LOST: Cancel Imperial Command (unless limiting your battle destiny draws).” '''What changed:''' “▲ Demotion.” → “Take Demotion into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “Target” → “For remainder of turn, cancel the game text of an Imperial (except”; “non-Jedi Imperial” → “Dark Jedi)”; “Imperial. Cancel target's game text for remainder of turn. LOST:” → “Imperial.<br />LOST:”; “(except when” → “(unless”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 1, slip 4. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
